svg.title: Ilmanen–White: two conical ends joined through four necks
svg.desc: Original genus-three schematic informed by Figure 1 and the graph description in the paper. An upper graph and its reflection join along four closed neck curves in the horizontal plane. The cutaway exposes the neck walls. Each outer rim continues to a conical end. Not a computed shrinker.

g.text: Two conical ends, joined through four necks
Ilmanen–White · genus h = 3 · the paper’s wheel parameter is g = 4
One connected surface, with two outward ends
Cutaway: upper and lower graphs meet at the necks
h + 1 neck curves in z = 0 give genus h; both ends are asymptotically conical.
Blue and gold show opposite sides of one surface. Outer rims and cut edges are display boundaries.
SCHEMATIC · the shrinker equation has not been solved
After Ilmanen–White, Figure 1 and Theorems 4.8, 7.6. Neck shapes, scale and cone slopes are illustrative.
